_comment: Golden `sanitize` vectors (task-3, path-collision parity). plugins/uns/exec_configure.go's sanitize is the one owner of this fact (architecture principle 4); api/src/edge/edit/model_rules.py keeps a native Python copy so preflight can predict Go's model-slot path collisions BEFORE execute. Necessary duplication (architecture principle 2, tier 2): one checked-in dataset judged by BOTH colca's Go suite (plugins/uns/sanitize_test.go) and the api Python suite (edge/tests/test_model_rules.py), so the two native copies can never drift apart silently. sanitize replaces '/', '+', '#', ' ' and any control character (codepoint < 0x20) with '_', trims leading/trailing '_' runs, and falls back to "tag" when nothing is left.
